notes.title: Solar War Playtest Discontinued Until Further Notice
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Unfortunately, I have decided to discontinue the playtest until further notice, due to various reasons. The playtest may be revived sometime in the future, but in the meantime, no updates are planned. I'm sorry for any inconvenience or disappointment that may have been caused by this.

notes.title: Reuploaded v0.5
notes.notes: -Patched bug that clipped the UI off screen for screen resolutions below 1080p by reverting a fix applied since 0.4. This resurfaces a different bug that this fix patched, where UI and gameplay elements could be misaligned. A more permanent fix will be applied later.
